Union Minister L. Murugan Resigns to Return to Grassroots Politics

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Member of Parliament L. Murugan has resigned from his position as Union Minister. Murugan stated his desire to return to grassroots politics as the reason for his resignation. The resignation comes amid speculation of a cabinet reshuffle.
